Text: Réspice nos, rerum ómnium Deus creátor et rector, [t] et, ut tuæ propitiatiónis sentiámus efféctum, [*] toto nos tríbue tibi corde servíre.
Changes: 2025-10-05 - Paul Prins: Correct week 24 prayer now included. Was week 23 prayer by mistake.
